Top-Rated Professional Materials For Your Projects
Comprehensive Resin Portfolio

eSUN’s resin lineup includes standard, tough, ABS-like, high-speed, and water-washable options, catering to functional prototypes, mechanical parts, and aesthetic creations. Tough resin rivals ABS+ in durability, ABS-like resins match traditional ABS filaments, HS100 enables up to 72% faster printing, and water-washable resins simplify post-processing.
Global Leader in 3D Printing Materials

eSUN is renowned for its balance of quality and affordability, making it one of the world’s leading manufacturers of 3D printing materials. With a product range spanning PLA, ABS, PETG, Nylon, TPU, and more, eSUN has earned recognition from global media and industry awards, trusted by both hobbyists and professionals.
Accessories and Complete Printing Support

Beyond materials, eSUN offers complementary printing accessories like the eBox filament dryer and eVacuum storage kit to keep filaments dry, tangle-free, and performance-ready. Detailed print parameters and guides are also provided, helping users quickly get started and optimize results — from hobbyists to professional makers.

eSUN’s PLA+ combines high strength with ease of printing, making it ideal for general 3D printing. PETG offers excellent layer adhesion, impact resistance, and low shrinkage, perfect for functional parts. ABS+ features improved stability and heat resistance, while the TPU series ranges from firm to soft options, catering to flexible designs and rubber-like applications.
